birth.tz_expect: America/Bogota (UTC-5, no DST in 1990; Colombia's only DST era was May 1992–Feb 1993)

arrived.presenting: just opened his own kitchen and can't taste the win; runs on the fear that he's about to be exposed as not good enough
arrived.in_her_words: Everybody claps and I'm back there thinking, they'll figure it out. Que no soy tan bueno como creen.

beliefs: I'm one bad service from being found out
the plate has to be perfect or I am nothing
protections: staying in the weeds so no one sees him rest
patterns: remakes a finished dish three times
measures his worth by the last review
resources: his abuela's recipes, still in her handwriting
the muscle memory of a line that never lets him drown
his sous-chef, who tells him when to go home
psyche.origin: a father who called cooking 'women's work' and never once ate what he made; the kitchen became the one place Marcos could be somebody

unaware_of: I'm one bad service from being found out
measuring his worth by the last review

beats.note: writes fast, sensory entries — heat, salt, the sound of the pass; keeps it about the food, not himself
